playbooks.name: Breach Detection & Response
playbooks.description: Playbook for triaging suspected compromise, validating scope, containing affected systems, and driving eradication with evidence preservation.

steps.title: Detect
steps.description: Validate alert fidelity, identify impacted assets, and open an incident bridge.

steps.title: Contain
steps.description: Isolate affected accounts, endpoints, or segments while minimizing business disruption.

steps.title: Investigate
steps.description: Collect logs, endpoint telemetry, memory artifacts, and authentication trails.

steps.title: Eradicate
steps.description: Remove persistence, patch exploited weaknesses, and rotate exposed credentials.

steps.title: Recover
steps.description: Restore services with heightened monitoring and documented approvals.

playbooks.name: Ransomware Containment
playbooks.description: Workflow for stopping encryption spread, protecting backups, coordinating executive response, and preparing restoration or negotiation decisions.

steps.title: Trigger Isolation
steps.description: Disconnect infected hosts and disable high-risk east-west paths immediately.

steps.title: Protect Backups
steps.description: Verify backup integrity and enforce immutability controls.

steps.title: Hunt Scope
steps.description: Identify patient zero, lateral movement, and privileged account misuse.

steps.title: Executive Escalation
steps.description: Notify leadership, legal, insurance, and IR partners.

steps.title: Restore Clean Systems
steps.description: Rebuild from trusted images and monitored data sources.

playbooks.name: DDoS Service Degradation Response
playbooks.description: Playbook for volumetric and application-layer denial-of-service events impacting internet-facing services.

steps.title: Confirm Attack Type
steps.description: Determine whether the event is volumetric, protocol, or application-layer.

steps.title: Engage Providers
steps.description: Activate CDN, WAF, ISP, and DDoS mitigation contacts.

steps.title: Apply Traffic Controls
steps.description: Rate-limit, geo-filter, or challenge suspicious requests as appropriate.

steps.title: Monitor Business Impact
steps.description: Track availability, latency, and customer-facing symptoms.

steps.title: Post-Event Review
steps.description: Tune protections and update thresholds after service stabilizes.

playbooks.name: Data Exfiltration Investigation
playbooks.description: Response flow for suspected unauthorized data movement involving staging systems, cloud storage, or outbound tunnels.

steps.title: Validate Alert
steps.description: Correlate data volume, destination, user context, and asset role.

steps.title: Restrict Transfers
steps.description: Block suspicious outbound paths and quarantine involved accounts.

steps.title: Quantify Exposure
steps.description: Identify datasets, records, and legal/regulatory implications.

steps.title: Preserve Evidence
steps.description: Retain logs, proxy traces, DLP events, and endpoint artifacts.

steps.title: Notify Stakeholders
steps.description: Coordinate privacy, legal, and customer communication requirements.

playbooks.name: Insider Threat Response
playbooks.description: Procedure for suspicious employee or contractor behavior involving privilege abuse, policy violations, or malicious intent.

steps.title: Open Restricted Case
steps.description: Limit case visibility to authorized investigators and HR/legal partners.

steps.title: Preserve Access Records
steps.description: Collect badge, VPN, PAM, and application activity logs.

steps.title: Coordinate with HR
steps.description: Align investigative steps with employment policy and legal review.

steps.title: Implement Targeted Controls
steps.description: Reduce privileges or increase monitoring without tipping off the subject prematurely.

steps.title: Decide Remediation
steps.description: Execute account actions, evidence handoff, and communication plan.

playbooks.name: Supply Chain Compromise
playbooks.description: Playbook for compromised vendors, software updates, managed services, or shared libraries impacting the environment.

steps.title: Identify Affected Dependencies
steps.description: Map impacted vendor products, packages, and connected systems.

steps.title: Disable Risky Integrations
steps.description: Suspend trust relationships, tokens, or update channels as needed.

steps.title: Scope Exposure
steps.description: Determine which workloads, accounts, and data were reachable.

steps.title: Patch or Replace
steps.description: Apply vendor mitigations or swap components where necessary.

steps.title: Strengthen Third-Party Controls
steps.description: Update supplier assessments, SBOM review, and approval workflows.

playbooks.name: Evidence Collection & Chain of Custody
playbooks.description: Standardized evidence handling process for incident investigations, legal hold, and forensic analysis support.

steps.title: Authorize Collection
steps.description: Confirm scope, approval, and handling requirements before acquisition.

steps.title: Capture Volatile Data
steps.description: Preserve memory, active connections, and running processes when appropriate.

steps.title: Acquire Non-Volatile Artifacts
steps.description: Collect disk, log, cloud audit, and configuration evidence with hashes.

steps.title: Record Chain of Custody
steps.description: Track who handled each artifact, when, and for what purpose.

steps.title: Secure Storage
steps.description: Store evidence in tamper-evident, access-controlled repositories.
